name: fundus-disease-analysis
description: AI-powered multi-disease analysis of fundus images from both standard (45°) and ultra-wide fundus cameras, covering glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, AMD, and dozens of ophthalmic conditions with structured diagnostic reports.

displayDescription.en: AI-powered multi-disease analysis of standard and ultra-wide fundus images, covering glaucoma, DR, AMD and dozens of conditions with inferred diagnosis, sign classification, detection, segmentation and structured reports.
displayDescription.zh: 基于普角与超广角眼底彩照的AI多病种分析，覆盖青光眼、糖网、AMD等数十种疾病的诊断与报告解读。
